title: Identification of Epigenetic Regulator-Associated Genes in Keloid Disease Through Integrated Bulk and Single-Cell Transcriptomics With RT-qPCR Validation.
authors: Wang, Yifei; Dou, Shuqian; Dai, Mingkun; Yang, Guoxun; Liu, Wenjun
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组学和机器学习识别瘢痕疙瘩中表观遗传相关基因，但核心是基因表达与临床验证，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: There exists a close correlation between epigenetic factors and the progression of keloid disease (KD). The research aims to identify the key genes linked to epigenetic factors in KD, which may provide new insights into the therapeutic management of KD. The four datasets (GSE113619, GSE145725, GSE181316, and GSE293834) and genes related to epigenetic factors (ERGs) were retrieved from public repositories. Machine learning algorithms combined with mRNA expression validation via RT-qPCR identified critical epigenetic factor-associated genes. Follow-up analyses included GSEA, immune cell infiltration assessment, therapeutic compound screening, and pseudotemporal trajectory analysis. RT-qPCR assays on clinical specimens confirmed the mRNA expression patterns of the identified genes. Three feature genes were identified, among which only HR and SMYD4 showed significant and consistent differential expression (p < 0.05). GSEA indicated enrichment of these genes in metabolic and cellular pathways including alpha-linolenic acid processing, riboflavin metabolism, and protein secretion mechanisms. Immune profiling showed elevated platelet frequencies and reduced dendritic cell populations in KD patients versus controls (p < 0.05). Computational screening identified 10 potential compounds for HR (including propylthiouracil, estradiol, and triiodothyronine) and 8 compounds for SMYD4 (including acetaminophen, bisphenol A, and pirinixic acid). Pseudotime analysis of smooth muscle cells and pericytes (SMC/PC) and melanocytes (MEL) showed that during cell differentiation, HR was predominantly expressed in MEL. Clinical validation confirmed these expression patterns. In the present investigation, two key genes associated with epigenetic factor were obtained, which might serve as potential exploratory biomarkers and warrant further epigenetic mechanistic investigation.
abstract_zh: 表观遗传因素与瘢痕疙瘩病（KD）的进展之间存在密切相关性。本研究旨在识别与KD中表观遗传因素相关的关键基因，这可能为KD的治疗管理提供新的见解。从公共数据库中获取了四个数据集（GSE113619、GSE145725、GSE181316和GSE293834）以及与表观遗传因素相关的基因（ERGs）。机器学习算法结合通过RT-qPCR进行的mRNA表达验证，识别出关键的表观遗传因素相关基因。后续分析包括GSEA、免疫细胞浸润评估、治疗化合物筛选和伪时间轨迹分析。对临床标本进行的RT-qPCR检测确认了所识别基因的mRNA表达模式。共识别出三个特征基因，其中仅HR和SMYD4表现出显著且一致的差异表达（p < 0.05）。GSEA表明这些基因在代谢和细胞通路中富集，包括α-亚麻酸加工、核黄素代谢和蛋白质分泌机制。免疫谱分析显示，与对照组相比，KD患者中血小板频率升高，树突状细胞群体减少（p < 0.05）。计算筛选确定了针对HR的10种潜在化合物（包括丙硫氧嘧啶、雌二醇和三碘甲状腺原氨酸）以及针对SMYD4的8种化合物（包括对乙酰氨基酚、双酚A和吡啶酸）。对平滑肌细胞和周细胞（SMC/PC）及黑色素细胞（MEL）的伪时间分析显示，在细胞分化过程中，HR主要在MEL中表达。临床验证确认了这些表达模式。在本研究中，获得了两个与表观遗传因素相关的关键基因，它们可能作为潜在的探索性生物标志物，并值得进一步进行表观遗传机制研究。
